config.label: Frankfurter API base URL
config.description: Frankfurter API base URL. Override for local testing or self-hosted instances.

config.label: Day range above which fx_get_timeseries considers automatic DataCanvas staging for SQL analytics
config.description: Day range above which fx_get_timeseries considers automatic DataCanvas staging for SQL analytics. Without canvas_id, series that fit the preview remain inline. DataCanvas is on by default; CANVAS_PROVIDER_TYPE=none returns ranges inline when canvas_id is omitted and rejects explicit staging.

config.label: Enable fx_dataframe_drop, which permanently removes one staged table or view from a DataCanvas
config.description: Enable fx_dataframe_drop, which permanently removes one staged table or view from a DataCanvas. Disabled by default; the tool is not registered (absent from tools/list) until set to true.
